dish: morning-picked Rusutsu asparagus, sweet corn and tomatoes; the stand's pizza
address: Route 230, Rusutsu, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Rusutsu growers' farm stand on Route 230 — asparagus, corn and tomatoes picked that morning in high season, and a pizza counter visitors detour for.

dish: yuri-ne (lily bulb) — monaka and castella made with it
n: Michi-no-eki Makkari Flower Center (道の駅 真狩フラワーセンター)
w: Makkari grows about 60% of Japan's edible lily bulbs — the station sells them fresh and baked into monaka and castella, under Mt Yōtei.
